In The Matter Of Suo Moto Public Interest ... vs The Chief
Secretary on 4 August, 2025
 1
 High Court Of Chhattisgarh At Bilaspur
 Wppil No. 75 of 2023
 In The Matter Of Suo Moto Public Interest Litigation
 Versus
 The Chief Secretary & Others
 Order Sheet
04/08/2025 Heard Mr. Y.S.Thakur, learned Additional Advocate
 General for the State/respondent No. 1 to 5 as well as Mr.
Ashish Tiwari, learned counsel appearing for the Municipal corporation, Bhilai-Charoda.
On 30.01.2025, the Secretary, Women and Child Development Department, Government of
Chhattisgarh as well as Director, Women and Child Development, Government of Chhattisgarh,
alongwith District Magistrate, Balod were directed to file their personal affidavits in the matter.

sentences.text:
Thereafter, on 05.03.2025, further time was sought by the learned State counsel which was allowed
and the time for filing of the affidavit was extended by two weeks.

In compliance of the order dated 30.01.2025, the Secretary, Government of Chhattisgarh,
Department of Women and Child Development, has filed her affidavit stating as under:
"1. That, vide order dated 30.01.2025, the Hon'ble Court was pleased to direct the
Secretary, Women and Child Development, Chhattisgarh, Raipur and the District
Magistrate, Balod to file their personal affidavit with respect to the report of the
Court Commissioner Shri Amiya Kant Tiwari.

2. It is most humbly and respectfully submitted by the deponent that the report
received from the Court Commissioner Shri Amiyakant Tiwari has been duly
examined and the deficiencies found in the report has also been met out by the
concerned authorities.

The District Programme Officer, Women and Child
Development, Balod has taken steps to remove deficiencies as pointed out by the

Copy of report alongwith the photograph submitted by
the District Programme Officer, Women and Child Development, Balod is filed
herewith as Annexure D/1 collectively.

"
Similar affidavit has been filed by the Collector / District Magistrate, Balod.
From perusal of the same, it appears that the situation has become better now.

Today, the matter has been listed for hearing as a news report has been published on 03.08.2025 in
Hindi Daily, Navbharat with a heading "Ldwy esa ijkslk dqRrs dh twBh lCth] 83 Nk=ksa dks jscht
Vhdk yxk] iykjh ds xzke yPNuiqj 'kkyk dk ekeyk " and Haribhoomi, with a heading "ykijokgh dh gn
ikj % e/;ku Hkkstu esas tkucw>dj ijkslk dqRrs dk twBk] fQj yxk;k jscht dk ,aVh Mkst ".

The aforesaid news report relates to a Government Middle School situated at village Lachhanpur of
Block Palari of District Balodabazar.

The said news states that on 28 th July, 2025, food which was
licked by a dog has been served to the students.

When the students informed their parents, a
meeting of the School Committee was held and under the pressure of the parents, 83 students were
administered two doses of anti-rabies each.

The angry parents have demanded enquiry against the
delinquents and to take stern action against them.
The Collector, Balodabazar, has temporarily
removed the Jai Lakshmi Swa Sahayta Samuh who had served the unhygienic food.

The incident has
been reported to the Chief Minister of the State to get the matter investigated.

The Sub Divisional
Magistrate, Palari has formed a committee headed by the Sub Divisional Officer who would
investigate the matter.

From the aforesaid news, it transpires that when the students saw the stray dogs licking the food, it
was informed to the school administration, however, the say of the school administration is that
they had restrained from serving the said food licked by the dogs but still the Swa Sahayta Samuh
distributed the same.
According to the news reported in Haribhoomi, 84 students had eaten

the said
food but 78 students were administered first doses of anti rabies.

The District Education Officer,
Balodabazar, has issued notices to the Head Master and Cluster Coordinator and upon receipt of
their reply, further action would be taken.

It is highly surprising that the Swa Sahayta Samuh who are responsible for serving food to the
students, are performing their duties in a casual manner without keeping in mind the safety and
hygiene.

The photograph published alongwith the news shows two utensils on clay stove lying in an
open area which could be eaten / soiled by any stray animals, be it dogs, pigs, rodents etc.

The
teachers who are posted in the school also appear to be least concerned about the safety of the
children which is gross negligence.

Both the aforesaid news state different number of children who
have been administered anti rabies doses.

As soon as it came to the knowledge of the teachers that
the food has been licked by the dog, it should have been disposed of and no students should have
been allowed to eat the same.
There appears to be serious dereliction on
the part of the Swa Sahayta Samuh as well as the teachers and the life of the students have been put to danger as once a person is infected with rabies, there is no cure available.

sentences.text: Providing food to the students studying in the schools is not an empty formality and the same has to be done with dignity.
A person, especially innocent child cannot be served any eatables which has been licked / soiled by a dog.

When the State Government is spending so much of funds for upliftment of the schools and its paraphernalia, then such lapses on the part of the authorities responsible for its functioning, is a matter of serious concern.

In view of the above, the Secretary, School Education Department, Government of Chhattisgarh, is directed to file his personal affidavit informing this Court as to (i) whether each and every student,
who had consumed the soiled food in the school, have been administered doses of anti rabies vaccine, (ii) what action has been taken against the Swa Sahayta Samuh as well as the Teachers/Head Master of the school concerned, (iii) whether any compensation has been given to the students on account of such negligence which has put their life in danger, (iv) and what precautionary measures the Department would take so as to prevent recurrence of such incidents in future.
Let this matter be listed on 19th August, 2025.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Bibhu Datta Guru) (Ramesh Sinha)
 JUDGE CHIEF JUSTICE  Rahul / Amit  AMIT  KUMAR  DUBEY In The Matter Of Suo Moto Public Interest ... vs The Chief Secretary on 4 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/52341865/
